description: uncaughtException listeners get the thrown value as is; setUncaughtExceptionCaptureCallback takes uncaught exceptions instead
argv: process.on('uncaughtException', (e, o) => console.log('listener', typeof e, e, o)); setTimeout(() => { throw 1; }, 1); setTimeout(() => { process.removeAllListeners('uncaughtException'); process.setUncaughtExceptionCaptureCallback((e) => console.log('captured', e.message, process.hasUncaughtExceptionCaptureCallback())); setTimeout(() => { throw new Error('boom'); }, 1); setTimeout(() => console.log('alive'), 10); }, 5); throw 'str';
